title: Nu-Quest Distribution Inc
description: Nu-Quest Distribution Inc. is a privately held pharmaceutical wholesaler based in Newfoundland and Labrador. The company specializes in the distribution of brand-name and generic medications, as well as medical devices. Its negligent attitude toward security and unwillingness to negotiate led to the leak of confidential documents, including supplier/customer pricing and price lists, drug transaction and compliance records, financial statements, employee personnel files, and legal documents. Due to our disclosure of these details, the company faces regulatory fines, license revocation, lawsuits, and damage to its competition and reputation.
